div.div:
Rules that make this trustworthy
• A01 can be CRITICAL only because the AI reader and the witness AGREED on every value in the equation, with no unread row in between.
• A model's visual opinion (V01, P1) can only raise suspicion; code findings set the document check and the policy file sets the level.
• The explainer never sees the document; every number it writes is checked against computed facts, or the template text is used.
• The person, not the model, settles it: the finding and the review item stay open until they do.
